patch: Google exact provider-email owner matching and safe relink
core_fixes: Reads actual google.com providerData email before profile resolution.
Auto-matches users.authEmail and usernameAuthEmails.email to the existing AZOBSS username.
Does not trust contactEmail alone for automatic ownership; secure password linking is required.
If Google is linked to the wrong established Firebase user, unlinks google.com only and preserves Email/Password identity.
Clears stale Google-link fields from the wrong Firestore profile.
Re-signs with the Google credential and binds it to the correct Firestore username owner.
If target has its own Firebase identity, falls back to username + password secure linking.
Preserves an old/stale target UID in previousAuthUids when a fresh Google Auth UID must be assigned.
